tokens.name: ui-stage
tokens.usage: Page background. Sovereign register = `ink`; Mission Control register = `mc-bg`. Set on `<body>` (or the `.pc` / `.mc` root).

tokens.name: ui-panel
tokens.usage: Panel and card fill. Sovereign panels are 97% glass over `ink`; Mission Control cards are the solid `mc-surface`.

tokens.name: ui-panel-raised
tokens.usage: Lighter panel for tiles that sit inside a panel (sphere cards, feature cards).

tokens.name: ui-text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings. 15.6:1 on `ui-stage` (sovereign); 15.1:1 (minted).

tokens.name: ui-text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, sub-lines, table headers. 7.7:1 on `ui-stage` (sovereign). Minted `mc-muted` is 4.0:1 on `mc-bg` — source value kept; use only at 14px+ or on `mc-surface`.

tokens.name: ui-text-dim
tokens.usage: Footers, hash tails, tertiary meta. 3.9:1 on `ui-stage` — decorative only, never for copy that must be read.

tokens.name: ui-accent
tokens.usage: The one accent per surface: section titles, active states, key figures. Auric gold (sovereign) or Minted green (Mission Control). 9.2:1 / 7.6:1 on stage.

tokens.name: ui-accent-alt
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for the console, API and data-plane surfaces. Steel (sovereign) or cyan (minted). 8.5:1 / 7.9:1 on stage.

tokens.name: ui-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Third accent for platinum figures (sovereign) and purple headings (minted). Minted `mc-purple` is 3.4:1 on `mc-bg`: headings 24px+ only, as the source uses it.

tokens.name: ui-rule
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline for panels, table rows, nav border.

tokens.name: ui-rule-strong
tokens.usage: Hairline for chips, pills, table header rows and hovered panels.

tokens.name: ui-success
tokens.usage: PASS / VERIFIED / LIVE. 5.5:1 (sovereign), 7.6:1 (minted) on stage. Always paired with the word.

tokens.name: ui-warning
tokens.usage: WARN / bear scenario. 5.6:1 (sovereign), 8.9:1 (minted) on stage. Always paired with the word.

tokens.name: ui-danger
tokens.usage: FAIL / breach. Sovereign `signal-fail` is 3.4:1 on `ink` — source value kept; show it with the word FAIL, 19px+ bold, or on `chrome-3` text. Minted `mc-red` is 5.1:1.

tokens.name: ui-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every input, button, tab and link. Chosen for this system (the source used a 45% steel border): 8.5:1 / 7.9:1 on stage.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Sovereign stage. Source `--ink`. The near-black every metal is lit against; 65% of any surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Sovereign stage, one step up. Source `--ink2`. Nav backdrop, jockey panels.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Sovereign stage, two steps up. Source `--ink3`. Image and video panel fill behind media.

tokens.name: panel-glass
tokens.usage: Panel fill at 97% over `ink` so the atmospheric gradient reads through. Source `--panel`.

tokens.name: panel-glass-2
tokens.usage: Raised panel fill (sphere cards, feature cards, bench cards). Source `--panel2`.

tokens.name: gold-1
tokens.usage: Deepest gold. Source `--gd1`. Bar-chart and progress gradient start; never text.

tokens.name: gold-2
tokens.usage: Bronze. Source `--gd2`. Equation labels, evidence-capsule glint, placeholder text. 4.6:1 on `ink` — small caps labels only.

tokens.name: gold-3
tokens.usage: Auric — the primary accent. Source `--gd3`. Section titles, chips, active tabs, key figures, gold dots. 9.2:1 on `ink`.

tokens.name: gold-4
tokens.usage: Pale gold. Source `--gd4`. Highlights inside the gold text gradient; never a fill.

tokens.name: gold-5
tokens.usage: Ivory-gold. Source `--gd5`. The top light of the gold sphere and gradient; use once per surface.

tokens.name: platinum-1
tokens.usage: Dimmest platinum. Source `--pt1`. Footer, meta rows, sub-labels (source uses it at 8px; 3.9:1 on `ink` — decorative only).

tokens.name: platinum-2
tokens.usage: Muted platinum. Source `--pt2`. Labels, table headers, nav links, uppercase captions. 7.7:1 on `ink`.

tokens.name: platinum-3
tokens.usage: Light platinum. Source `--pt3`. Table first columns, system tags, glints on platinum cards.

tokens.name: platinum-4
tokens.usage: Platinum white. Source `--pt4`. Top light of the platinum text gradient.

tokens.name: chrome-1
tokens.usage: Dark chrome. Source `--cr1`. Reserved for chrome gradient shadows.

tokens.name: chrome-2
tokens.usage: Chrome mid. Source `--cr2`. Long-form body copy inside panels, table cells. 6.2:1 on `ink`.

tokens.name: chrome-3
tokens.usage: Chrome light — the default text colour of the sovereign register. Source `--cr3`. `body` colour, step titles, console text. 15.6:1 on `ink`.

tokens.name: chrome-4
tokens.usage: Pure white. Source `--cr4`. Only inside the chrome text gradient and sphere highlights.

tokens.name: steel-1
tokens.usage: Deep steel. Source `--st1`. Steel progress-gradient start.

tokens.name: steel-2
tokens.usage: Steel. Source `--st2`. Console borders and tints at alpha; gradient mid. 3.5:1 on `ink` — never text.

tokens.name: steel-3
tokens.usage: Steel light — the console / data-plane accent. Source `--st3`. Code keywords, API labels, active API mode, steel dots. 8.5:1 on `ink`.

tokens.name: steel-4
tokens.usage: Steel white. Source `--st4`. Console labels and agent messages; top light of the steel gradient.

tokens.name: signal-pass
tokens.usage: PASS / VERIFIED / LIVE / ● COMPLIANT. Source `--pass`. Status dots, audit PASS cells, nav status. 5.5:1 on `ink`.

tokens.name: signal-warn
tokens.usage: WARN and bear-scenario cells. Source `--warn`. 5.6:1 on `ink`.

tokens.name: signal-fail
tokens.usage: FAIL. Source `--fail`. 3.4:1 on `ink` — source value kept; always with the word FAIL and never below 19px bold.

tokens.name: hairline

tokens.name: hairline-2
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: chips, pills, active tabs, table header rules, hovered cards. Source `--bd2`.

tokens.name: hairline-gold

tokens.name: hairline-gold-strong

tokens.name: hairline-steel

tokens.name: hairline-steel-strong

tokens.name: hairline-pass
